why: Unchanged from the version the earlier review approved: it clears 'wh-check-' + id (ckKey's key) next to 'wh-used-' + id. render.js sets both keys before Remove and checks both are null afterwards; the gate's render checks pass (verify/out/render.json has no failures).

The mechanics are right, and the earlier review's fixes landed. Every fold starts closed. Once-per-battle lines reuse the Overview's boxes (ticks / abilityTicks / copyKey in wh-used), so Reset, which writes only wh-check, leaves them alone; render.js checks this and passes. A copy that cannot be used has its own id ('|na' in aid), so it gets its own boxes: 'Rage Eternal · Slaughterbound  Not leading a unit in this list' is a separate line in standard, next to the usable copy. Stored moments go only to their moment: Harbingers of Dread and Icon of Khorne appear only under Start of the battle round. There are no stratagems. One change is needed, together with the ckOption fix: a once-per-battle option that ckOption now marks x with via (Kindred Sorcery's Imbued Manifestation and Wrath of the Immaterium) must stay under Once per battle where it is chosen, not drop to When unclear. The fixed line does that; tested by rendering every list, and pubstomper is unchanged. Not fixed here, owner decisions: (1) what a once-per-battle use puts in force is never shown under Active now, because the once branch `continue`s. Archslaughterer ('every Blessing of Khorne is active for this unit until the start of your next turn') appears only as a box in Command · Your turn, which goes against scope rule (c). (2) The abilities a listed ability selects among are not shown as what it puts in force. These are Wrathful Presence's three (The Blood God’s Favour, Driven by Ultimate Rage, Overwhelming Wrath), Unearthly Power's Crimson King abilities (Impossible Form, Time Flux), Full Throttle's Throttlerokkit abilities, and Rod of the War Forge's Icon of War (Fanatical Devotion, Adaptive Tactics, The Fires of Mars). The FAQ in data.js says Icon of War's unit is selected 'When you have selected the Icon of War ability you want to use' (Command phase). Icon of War was under When unclear before; it has now dropped out entirely. (3) Inert lines are listed, marked: Bondsman on 6-bigs and 4-megas, whose units are all TITANIC with no ARMIGER, and the Rage Eternal copy that is not leading. Nothing about them needs remembering. (4) There is no End of the battle round section. Pledges to the Dark Prince's end-of-round check ('At the end of the battle round, if the number of enemy units destroyed … your WARLORD model suffers D3 mortal wounds') is shown only at the Start of the battle round. Deed 5–6 ('completed at the end of the battle round') sits under When unclear.

The code does what its description says: an option is listed when it is s, or when its rule is listed and it is not a. The scope error is in derive's input. ruleTables sets a only from a WHEN line, so Malefic Surge's three options, which have no WHEN line but whose own words open with a unit activation, are listed. 'Diabolic Power: When this unit is selected to shoot or fight …', 'Unholy Hunger: When a model in this unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move …' and 'Unnatural Fortitude: When this unit is selected as the target of an attack …' all show under TO DO NOW in Command · Your turn (infernal-lance). This breaks the hard rule: 'selected to shoot/fight' belongs on the datasheet. The fix is in verify/derive.js ruleTables (not a todo item). Replace `if(seqTrigger(o.text)) e.s = 1; else if(when && SEQ.activation.test(when[1])) e.a = 1;` with `const first = sentences(plain(rulesText(o.text)))[0] || ''; if(seqTrigger(o.text)) e.s = 1; else if(when ? SEQ.activation.test(when[1]) : /^\W*when\b/i.test(first) && SEQ.activation.test(first)) e.a = 1;`. Tested with derive --write: only those three options gain a. The Blessings of Khorne effects ('Each time a model in this unit makes …') stay listed, and the three lines leave the screen.

s, a stored moment (ckStored's stored flag, now set), or a once-per-battle use. It matches render.js's listed() and the owner's (a)/(b). Once-per-battle uses triggered by a unit's activation are listed because they are once per battle: Boss’ Ammo Runt, Ammo Runts, Bomb Squig, Resilient Organism, Catch Dat Red Bit, Incandaeum. This follows rule (b), but the owner should confirm that (b) wins over the activation exclusion.

The fallback `rule.t || rule.at ? { t:rule.t, at:rule.at }` files an option that has no trigger of its own and no use that can be read under TO DO NOW at its rule's trigger. Scope rule (c) says options of listed rules go under Active now for their duration, and where timing can't be read they go under When unclear, not a guess. Cases: Might of Khorne under TO DO NOW in both Command phases (big-demons-baby), and Mantra of Discipline, Binharic Courage (Aura), Shroudpsalm (Aura) and Aegis Protocol under TO DO NOW in Command · Your turn (purge-goes-the-foe). These are states 'until the start of your next Command phase' or 'until it enters a different one', not things to do. The fix files them under When unclear. via keeps a once-per-battle option filed where it is chosen; this needs the matching screenChecklist line. Tested by rendering every list: those five lines move to When unclear, and Kindred Sorcery's once boxes are unchanged. render.js's `oe` fallback (`{ t:e.t, at:e.at }`) needs the same change.

The earlier review's fix landed. Wreckin’ and Lootin’ is u 'shooting:your'. Knights of Legend has no u; its 'Feel No Pain 6+' no longer leaks. Dreadherder ('until the end of the turn') keeps 'shooting:your,fight:your'. Two wrong trigger phases come from table 1's trigPh (timing(), not this function). Umbralefic Crystal gets t 'command:your,movement:your' from 'This unit must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase', which is its effect, so its once box also shows in Movement · Your turn. Reborn in Blood gets t 'movement:your' from 'in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase'.

Checked against every rule and ability of the 17 lists. It is wrong in five places. Wrongly included: (1) Thrill Seekers. 'It cannot target a unit it was within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn' names a past moment as a condition, not a trigger, so it shows as ACTIVE NOW in Movement (both turns), Shooting · Your turn and Charge · Your turn (defilers-and-friends). (2) Warpmeld Sacrifice. 'Each time … is selected to shoot or fight … can make a Warpmeld Sacrifice. … At the end of the phase, that TZEENTCH MUTANT unit suffers D3 mortal wounds' is the activation's consequence, read sentence by sentence (mucho-mutantes, 5 sections). Daemonic Patrons has the same shape and is excluded. (3) Binding Tendrils. 'In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy INFANTRY unit hit …' is a unit activation; Rokkit Barrage and Sanctified Flames ('when this unit has shot') are excluded. Wrongly excluded: (4) Reborn in Blood. 'At the start of the battle round, when you make a Blessings of Khorne roll, if this model is destroyed, you can use a triple 6 …' is a fixed moment; '(is|are) destroyed' treats the state 'if this model is destroyed' as an activation. It is missing from standard, super-terminators and big-demons-baby. (5) Code Chivalric's Deed 1–2. 'This Deed is completed at the end of a turn if that CHARACTER is destroyed' is dropped for the same reason, while Deeds 3–4 and 5–6 are listed. The fix works paragraph by paragraph. In a paragraph that opens with a unit activation, a later moment counts only with a choice of its own (Blood Tithe's 'At the start of the Command phase, you can spend' stays). A moment that is only a past reference ('was/were … at the start of the turn') is cut out. In SEQ.activation, 'after this unit/model has shot/fought/moved/charged' is added and '(is|are) destroyed' is dropped. 'when this model is destroyed' is still caught by the when-clause alternative, and 'the first time' by its own. Tested with derive --write: exactly those five entries change, and nothing else in CHECKLIST. render.js's own copy (seqOwn) needs the same change. The fix also takes the ruleTables `a` line given under ckOptListed.

Code identical to the version the earlier review approved; only its key changed. The call sites now pass the own-words text and the ckEntry / option-trigger entry. Checked: War Cry → 'Riled up (War Cry) · Waaagh!' in every phase of both turns ('until the end of the next turn', from either Command phase). Makari → every phase except Command · Your turn ('until the start of your next turn', from Movement · Your turn). Krumpin' Time and Even More Dakka ('If this unit is **riled up**') are skipped. Intimidating Motivation and Keep Huntin'! carry f, but are rightly not listed: 'at the start or end of this unit’s move' is a unit activation. Not covered: a state that is not a bold rule name, such as Malefic Surge's 'Empowered' or Archslaughterer's 'every Blessing of Khorne is active'.

Both edge cases from the earlier review are fixed, called directly: battle from 'End of your opponent’s turn' gives every phase of both turns, and phase from 'Start of the battle round' gives x. Also checked: round from the start of the round gives everything; next from command:either gives everything; yournext from movement:your gives command:opp plus movement…fight either; yournext from shooting:opp gives only the rest of that turn; turn from shooting:your gives shooting, charge and fight of your turn; next from the end of the opponent's turn gives your turn. These are the durations of War Cry and Makari as shown.

The Example lines are now stripped: Martial Ka’tah is {t:'command:your'}, with no Movement use. But an option that ends in a list leaves the list's '- ' lines in the rule's own words. In Malefic Surge, Unnatural Fortitude's '… select one of the following to apply until the end of the phase:' is followed by '- Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.' and '- Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.'. These stay in, so the rule gets u 'shooting:opp,fight:either', and 'Malefic Surge · Infernal Lance' shows as ACTIVE NOW in Shooting · Their turn and both Fight phases (infernal-lance). The fix cuts those lines with the option. Tested with derive --write: only Malefic Surge changes, losing that u.

The earlier review's fix landed: only the stored moment, plus stored:1 for ckListed. Icon of Khorne only under Start of the battle round (standard, princes, big-demons-baby). Icon of War (no at) is no longer listed. Its drop-out is a scope question, raised under screenChecklist.
